From: Liam O'Connell <liam@indietools.io>

Subject: Partnership pilot: lightweight instrumentation for SDKs

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from IndieTools — we build a small set of developer tools that many ISVs embed alongside LangChain/LlamaIndex to surface telemetry from model calls. We've been experimenting with a very low-touch instrumentation shim that adds trace headers and emits a small set of metrics (request_id, model, tokens, latency_ms).

Would Redwood be interested in a short pilot (4 weeks) to include a lightweight patch in our SDK and measure delta in latency/cost on a couple of sample workloads? Our ask is simple: ship a test patch + a short checklist for what telemetry fields you prefer. We'll supply a minimal PR and a small test harness.

If useful, cc'ing a couple of folks on our side to help scope (I can come on a 30-min call this week).

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Head of Integrations | IndieTools Ltd

- Can you share the minimal PR and a short README for the test harness?

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Moving this to an internal thread to capture technical checklist before the sync. Notes below (raw):

- Acceptance criteria for pilot (minimal):
  * PR applies cleanly to LangChain/LlamaIndex helper layers (python + node).
  * No visible tail-latency impact >5% for median; 99th should be within SLO with opt-in disabled.
  * Telemetry payloads must NOT include user PII or full prompts (only token counts + model id).

- Telemetry schema suggestion (keeps size small):
  * trace_id (string) — prefer X-Redwood-TraceId header or trace parent
  * model_name (string) — normalized (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-redwood)
  * provider_variant (string) — hosted/dedicated/private
  * prompt_tokens (int), completion_tokens (int), total_tokens (int)
  * latency_ms (int)
  * error_code (string|null)
  * sample_bucket (string) — optional low-fidelity hashed prompt fingerprint for QA only

- Implementation notes:
  * Prefer a non-blocking emitter (background send with best-effort retry).
  * Provide developer opt-in flag (e.g., INSTRUMENTATION=enabled).
  * Provide a small test harness that can replay 100 requests / minute to validate overhead.

- Owners: Priyom = runtime review and perf validation; Marissa = partner success / contract side; Grace = console/telemetry mapping (dashboards).

Attaching the spec Liam sent (saved to drive) and will capture the PR link in the sync.

[Attachment: indietools_sdk_spec.md]
